# Group copied knowledge without collapsing different component scopes

Knowledge retrieval groups a lesson with its Markdown mirror, historical summary, original lesson and portable copy. Claim identity includes repository, component and paths. A copied summary does not become a second independent source. Keep different text and component scopes separate. The focused conflict-and-scope test passed; this does not resolve conflicting interpretations.

Scope: knowledge.
